facts.fact: Ahram Online reports PAPSS currently works across 30 African countries, including Egypt.
PAPSS chief executive Mike Ogbalu says PAPSS plans to connect to Instapay to widen Egypt-Africa cross-border payments.
Ogbalu says PAPSS transaction volume rose about 1,000 percent in 2026 and value about 120 percent, with transfer costs down by up to 95 percent and average processing time 7 seconds.
